features: Double the Security (Pack of 2): Why stop at one? This 2-camera bundle is designed for complete property surveillance. Monitor your living room and main gate simultaneously from one screen, ensuring zero blind spots across your home or office.

Government-Grade Trust (STQC Certified): Don't compromise on data privacy. As an STQC Certified device, the Protect Bot meets stringent Indian government security standards, ensuring your private video feeds stay private and your hardware is built to last.

AI-Powered Human Detection: Say goodbye to false alarms from pets or shadows. The intelligent AI specifically identifies human movement and "follows" the subject across the room with its 360° pan-tilt mechanism, keeping the intruder in focus.

Vivid Color Vision, 24/7: Switch from grainy black-and-white to crystal-clear color. Even in pitch-black conditions, the integrated spotlights illuminate the area, providing full-color evidence when you need it most..

Interactive Two-Way Talk: It’s more than a camera; it’s a communication hub. With "Full Duplex" audio, you can have a real-time conversation with people at home or warn off trespassers directly from your smartphone.

Smart Storage & Voice Control: Save weeks of footage with support for up to a 256GB Memory card. For the ultimate smart home experience, ask Alexa or Google to "Show me the Front Door" to see your live feed instantly on your smart display.

Plug-and-Play 2.4GHz Wi-Fi Setup: Enjoy a frustration-free installation. Using the IEEE 802.11b/g/n standard, these cameras offer stable long-range wireless connectivity, allowing you to place them anywhere within your Wi-Fi signal range without messy Ethernet cables.

Real-Time Remote Access (Android/iOS/Web): View your live 3MP HD feed from anywhere in the world. Whether you're on mobile data or another Wi-Fi network, the Manomay Pro / Truecloud app provides instant, lag-free access to your security stream.
